statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-34743 is a heap buffer overflow in liblzma, the XZ Utils compression library, in XZ Utils 5.8.2 and earlier: if lzma_index_decoder() decodes an Index that contains no Records, a later lzma_index_append() on the result allocates too little memory and writes past it. Upstream fixed it in XZ Utils 5.8.3 with https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/commit/c8c22869e780ff57c96b46939c3d79ff99395f87 and notes that the lzma_index functions are rarely used directly by applications (https://tukaani.org/xz/index-append-overflow.html). Debian backported the fix to trixie in xz-utils 5.8.1-1+deb13u1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-34743, Debian bug #1132497). The DHI xz-utils packages are built from Debian's later 5.8.1-1+deb13u2 source, and the changelog shipped in the published liblzma5 package carries the 5.8.1-1+deb13u1 entry 'CVE-2026-34743: Buffer overflow in lzma_index_append()'. Every xz-utils build currently published in the DHI Debian repository is built from that source, so the fixed version is the lowest published build. Earlier builds made from Debian's 5.8.1-1 source do not contain the fix.
